title: Massachusetts revocable trust — reviewing a draft prepared elsewhere

rules.statement: A trustee exculpation or indemnity clause must carve out gross negligence and bad faith, not willful misconduct alone. A carve-out limited to willful misconduct leaves the beneficiaries without recourse for conduct well short of intentional wrongdoing, and is narrower than the firm accepts.
rules.preferredLanguage: except to the extent such claims arise from the Trustee's own willful misconduct, bad faith, or gross negligence

rules.statement: A waiver of the trustee's bond must be limited to trustees named in the instrument and their successors. An unqualified waiver running to any person who ever serves removes the protection at exactly the point it is needed — when a trustee nobody chose is appointed.

A discretionary distribution standard must direct the trustee whether to consider a beneficiary's other resources. Silence on the point is the deviation: it leaves the trustee to guess, and the answer changes both the tax treatment and the creditor exposure of the interest.
